method: Controlled fixtures on the designated builder; no model, database or external service is called by the checks.

reviewBoundary.limit: This tests the normalizer only. Confidence is a supplied score, not a calibrated probability of truth; no release was published.

datesAndIdentity.limit: Synthetic parser inputs only. A parser accepting a URL is not independent evidence that a real announcement happened.

domCounting.limit: DOMParser runs without executing scripts. This does not replace hydrated browser interaction tests.

staticAssets.limit: Small reproduction of the immutable-path check, not a test of all browser sessions, Docker provenance or database rollback.
